name: Weekly Usage Report — DB → formatted Slack #syntaro-metrics

parameters.query:
WITH weekly_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM run_history WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0) AS issues_fixed,
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM run_history WHERE status = 'failed' AND completed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0) AS issues_failed,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(tokens_total) FROM agent_analytics_runs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0) AS tokens_consumed,
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM usage_records WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0) AS active_tenants,
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0) AS new_signups,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM credit_transactions WHERE type IN ('purchase', 'subscription') AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0) AS total_revenue_cents,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts) AS total_accounts
)

WITH prev_week_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM run_history WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' AND completed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0) AS prev_issues_fixed,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(tokens_total) FROM agent_analytics_runs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0) AS prev_tokens,
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM usage_records WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' AND timestamp < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0) AS prev_active_tenants,
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0) AS prev_signups,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM credit_transactions WHERE type IN ('purchase', 'subscription') AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0) AS prev_revenue_cents
)
SELECT * FROM prev_week_stats
